daily.today_energy: Mercury's vibes are whispering softly today, Pisces. You're in a reflective mood—lean into it. This is your moment to journal, daydream, and let your intuition do the talking. Trust the quiet.
daily.love: Someone's been thinking about you more than usual. Whether it's romantic or platonic, the connection is deepening. Don't overthink it; just show up authentically and let things unfold naturally.
daily.career: Your creative energy is hitting different today. That project or idea you've been sitting on? Start moving it forward. Your unique perspective is exactly what needs to happen right now.
daily.health: Your nervous system could use some grounding. Try touching grass, drinking water slowly, or moving your body in a way that feels good. Listen to what your body's actually asking for, not what you think it should want.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to lean into your intuitive gifts, Pisces. The cosmos is whispering that it's time to trust yourself more and overthink less. Something shifts by midweek that feels like permission to be authentically you.
weekly.love: Romance thrives when you're real. Stop curating the perfect version of yourself for whoever's watching. Your vulnerability is literally your superpower right now, and the right people will feel that.
weekly.career: Your creative ideas are hitting different this week. The universe is basically saying your perspective matters—even if it feels unconventional. Trust the vision, even if others need time to catch up.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for more rest and less rushing. Honor what feels good without forcing routines that drain you. Moving your energy through whatever brings you joy (not obligation) is the real move.
